scares.description: Scene abruptly cuts to a cat’s loud hiss.
There is a whooshing noise as Emily shuts the door to her room.
Emily is flung back onto the bed by an unseen force.
Lightning flashes as Emily stares out of the window.
Emily turns to the student beside her and sees his face turns demonic.
The faces of the women in the church turn demonic.
Father Moore sees a silhouette outside of the jail cell.
Emily screams as Jason touches her.
